description: Extensions for OrbTorrent, the macOS torrent app: TypeScript hooks that check a download before it starts or act on it after it finishes, made and tested with the orb tool.
rules: Make a new extension with `npm create @orbtorrent/extension@latest <name>`, then read the AGENTS.md in its folder.
Check the work with `npx orb test`, `npx orb build` and `npx orb lint` until all three pass.
Allowing development extensions, allowing a folder and confirming an install happen in OrbTorrent, by the person. Ask them; never try to get around it.
